about.title: We sell customer retention, not wallet technology.
about.description: WalletOS helps small and medium businesses launch digital loyalty in minutes. Bilingual Arabic and English, MENA/GCC first.
about.missionBody: Make loyalty as simple as a paper stamp card, with the reach of Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Merchants get a dashboard. Customers never download an app.
about.v1Body: No accounts, no apps. Just a pass in the wallet they already use.
about.v2Body: Signup to a live enrollment QR in under two minutes.
about.v3Body: Every scan updates the pass instantly. No lost cards, no fake stamps.

featuresWallet.title: Your loyalty card lives in their wallet
featuresWallet.description: Customers add a pass with one tap. No app store, no login after enrollment.
featuresWallet.b1Body: Signed .pkpass cards with your brand colors, reward copy, and QR.
featuresWallet.b2Body: Loyalty objects that update when progress changes.
featuresWallet.b3Body: One source of truth for what the pass shows on both platforms.
featuresWallet.directAnswer: To issue an Apple Wallet pass, a merchant signs a .pkpass file with their brand colors, reward copy, and a QR code; the customer adds it with one tap and it updates automatically after every scan, no login required. Google Wallet works the same way through a Loyalty Object that updates live on the customer's phone.

app.q: Do my customers need to download an app?
app.a: No. Passes live in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet. Customers add their card in seconds. Nothing to download, no account to create.

iphone.a: Yes. The card adds straight to Apple Wallet on any iPhone. No separate app, no App Store visit.

android.a: Yes. The card adds to Google Wallet on any Android phone with the Google Wallet app, which comes preinstalled on most devices.

walletApp.q: Does the customer need to already have Apple Wallet or Google Wallet?
walletApp.a: Apple Wallet is built into every iPhone. Google Wallet comes preinstalled on most Android phones, or is a free one-time download from the Play Store. Neither is something we ask a customer to set up.

scanning.q: How does a merchant scan a customer's card?
scanning.a: Staff open the scanner from the WalletOS dashboard on any phone's camera, no separate hardware needed. It reads the pass's QR or barcode and updates it instantly.

customize.q: Can I customize the card with my own logo and colors?
customize.a: Yes. Upload your logo, set your brand colors, pick a cover image and stamp icon. Every customer's wallet card reflects your branding, not ours.

reward.q: What happens when a customer reaches their reward?
reward.a: Their pass shows the reward is ready to redeem. Staff confirm it at the next visit, and the card resets for the next loyalty cycle.

paper.q: How does WalletOS replace a paper stamp card?
paper.a: Staff scan the customer’s QR. Stamps or points update on the pass in real time. Cards can’t be lost, forgotten, or faked.

cost.q: What does it cost to start?
cost.a: Start on the free plan with one active program. Upgrade to Starter or Pro when you need more programs and customers.

pos.q: Does it work with my POS?
pos.a: WalletOS runs independently of your POS. No till changes required. Staff scan from any phone on the dashboard.
